gaps.name: STATIC_LIVE_PLAN
gaps.finding: The freeze carried a fully materialized plan and did not derive slot, lock, identities, clocks, outputs, or downstream arguments at runtime.

gaps.name: SHORT_LIVED_ONLY
gaps.finding: Every stage was treated as a short child invocation, which could not represent the preloaded RDS lease or Market Data recorder lifecycles.

gaps.name: SECRET_ENV_NOT_INJECTED
gaps.finding: SecretVariableNames were declared but BuildStartInfo copied only inherited system variables.

gaps.name: GENERIC_ENVELOPE_REQUIRED
gaps.finding: The runner required every native tool to emit Arch7bChildOutputEnvelope directly.

gaps.name: INCOMPLETE_AUTHORITY_BINDING
gaps.finding: Supervisor, runtime inventory, Core repository, tracked inventory, static authority, and CLI path bindings were incomplete.

gaps.name: FREEZE_PLAN_SHA_AMBIGUITY
gaps.finding: expected-freeze-manifest-sha256 was also used as the live plan file SHA.

gaps.name: OUTPUT_BOUND_AFTER_READ
gaps.finding: ReadToEndAsync accumulated output before enforcing limits.

gaps.name: SYNTHETIC_SECRET_SCAN_ONLY
gaps.finding: Only ARCH7B_SECRET_SENTINEL was scanned; exact leased values were not checked.

evidence: rds-secret-client.mjs reads the credential inside Core
rds-secret-lease.mjs owns and releases the in-memory value
bracket-fast-handoff-v3.mjs starts consumers through the Core lease contract
fast-seal-v3-cli.mjs consumes versioned Core authorities without exposing the value
